apps.title: Stunt Car Getaway: Cop Chase
apps.summary:
The cops are on your tail. The getaway is up to you.
Stunt Car Getaway puts you behind the wheel of a classic muscle car in the cities of 70s America. Take crime jobs from shady contacts, outrun the police, drift through traffic and smash your way to the big score.
THREE CITIES TO TAKE OVER • San Francisco: steep hills, an elevated freeway over the bay and the old wharf • Los Angeles: palm-lined boulevards, the beach and the pier, and a three-storey parking garage • Chicago: elevated trains, red-brick streets, the river and the tunnels under the city
CRIME JOBS Escape the cops, ram the runaway car before it gets away, pick up the bank robber and get him out, tail a car without being seen, play the decoy, carry fragile cargo, race through checkpoints and smash everything in sight. Each city has three tiers of jobs, Street Jobs, Big League and Most Wanted, with a boss job at the end of each.
WILD POLICE CHASES Raise the heat and the police come harder: more cars and ambushes from side streets. Lose them in the back alleys, or wreck them.
CLASSIC MUSCLE CARS Nine classic cars, from big-engined coupes to heavy sedans. Upgrade the engine, armour and handling, and give your car a new paint job.
REAL DAMAGE Every hit dents the bodywork and shakes the panels loose. Pull into a gas station to get patched up before the next job.
FREE RIDE AND SURVIVAL Cruise the streets in Free Ride, or see how long you can last in Survival with the whole police force after you.
EASY TO PLAY Short jobs made for mobile. Pick the controls that suit you: tap to steer, buttons, or a steering wheel.
Earn stars, open new cities, and become the most wanted driver in America.

apps.title: Ninja Arashi 3
apps.summary:
Become a legendary ninja. Rescue your son. Uncover the truth.

Ninja Arashi 3 continues a dark journey of revenge, mystery, and survival. Step into the shadow of a dangerous world, where deadly enemies stand in your way and the past holds answers you may not be ready to face.

Play as Ninja Arashi and fight through treacherous landscapes filled with hidden traps, fierce warriors, and restless spirits. Follow the trail of your missing son, discover forgotten memories, and uncover the secrets behind the tragedy that shattered your family. Every shadow may conceal an enemy—or a clue.

MASTER DEADLY NINJA COMBAT
Combine swift sword attacks, precise kunai throws, and powerful abilities to overcome your enemies. In Ninja Arashi 3, timing and positioning can turn a desperate encounter into a decisive victory.

• Challenging action platformer
Jump across dangerous gaps, dodge lethal traps, and master demanding platforming challenges.

• Stealth and surprise attacks
Strike from the shadow, approach enemies from behind, and choose the right moment to attack.

• Powerful elemental abilities
Harness fire, ice, poison, lightning, and dark powers. Experiment with different abilities to shape your fighting style.

• Intense boss battles
Face formidable opponents, learn their attack patterns, and put your ninja skills to the test.

• Equipment and artifacts
Strengthen your character, upgrade your equipment, and collect mysterious artifacts to prepare for greater challenges.

• A dark fantasy adventure
Explore a world of shadow and mystery, meet memorable characters, and discover stories hidden beyond the main path.

DISCOVER WHAT LIES BEYOND REVENGE
The journey in Ninja Arashi 3 goes beyond combat. Listen to those you meet, take on side quests, and make choices that affect their stories. Some need your help. Others remember things you have forgotten.

Your son is still out there. The truth is waiting.

Enter the shadow. Begin your journey in Ninja Arashi 3.

apps.title: DIGIMON ALYSION
apps.summary:
DIGIMON ALYSION is finally here!
Enjoy a brand-new Digimon card game world!

■ Original Story!
A brand-new beginning with an original cast of characters!
You might even encounter all-new Digimon! Embark on an exciting new adventure alongside a whole host of characters and Digimon!

■ Beginner Friendly!
Dive right into the action with detailed guides on everything from card layouts and usage to the battle basics!
The tutorial even makes it easy for trading card game beginners to play!
Learn the rules and card gameplay while playing through the story! Experience the thrilling strategic showdowns of the Digimon Card Game!

■ Free Daily Pack!
Open a free pack every day and obtain cards!
Create your own ultimate deck by putting together cards that fit your preferred strategy and playstyle!

■ Choose Your Battles!
Spend your time battling fierce opponents from around the world and aim for the top of the rankings!
Or take it easy and sharpen skills at your own pace by sparring against your friends and favorite characters!
Enjoy everything the world of DIGIMON ALYSION has to offer!

■ Collect Countless Cool Cards!
Alongside previous cards from the Digimon Card Game, all-new cards will be joining the lineup for DIGIMON ALYSION!
Plus, collect a wide variety of cards, from dazzling Shiny Cards and fan-favorite Alt-Art Cards, to spectacularly animated Premium Alt-Art Cards!
Grow your collection with a diverse selection of cards and enjoy Digimon Cards to the fullest!

■ Breed Digimon!
It wouldn't be Digimon without the breeding mechanic! Digivolve your Digimon all the way to Mega!
Aim to complete all 100+ entries in the Digidex!

And that's not all! There's plenty of other features that make the Digimon Card Game easy and fun to play!
Whether you're a seasoned veteran or just getting started, come and experience the Digimon Card Game by playing DIGIMON ALYSION!

Explore an open world where you can drive cars, ride motorcycles, fly helicopters and take control of vehicles equipped with machine guns. Choose your ride and bring Sheru Bhai’s signature attitude to every journey.

BRING THE ROYAL ATTITUDE
Play as Sheru Bhai, the distinctive white lion whose royal outfits and confident personality make every entrance memorable.

• Playable white lion character, Sheru Bhai
• Cars to drive
• Motorcycles to ride
• Helicopters to fly
• Vehicles equipped with machine guns
• Royal character style

Roads, rides and the sky await. Enter Sheru Bhai’s world and make your next entrance a royal one!

apps.title: Sheru Bhai Life Simulator Game
apps.summary:
Sheru Bhai Game 3D is an open-world action game where you play as Sheru Bhai: a royal white lion in a white-and-gold suit, full of desi Bhai swagger, and the richest lion in the city. Explore a big island, drive luxury supercars, fly jets and a helicopter, live in your own gold mansion, change your royal look and grow your fame with your phone's photo app.

Your Royal Mansion
• Live in Sheru Bhai's mansion on Royal Hill, with marble floors, gold lion statues, a pool deck and a gold room with a huge pile of gold.
• Walk through every room: the master suite, the office, the guest room and more.
• Doors swing open as you walk through, and the main gate slides open when you arrive on foot or by car.
• Make it rain: throw money with the lion money button.

Your Royal Look
• Open the wardrobe in the master bedroom and pick your style.
• Suits: White Gold, White Classic and Black Premium.
• Specs: gold aviators, black shades or diamond specs.
• On your head: a gold crown, a diamond crown, or a black or white cap.

Supercars, Bikes and Aircraft
• 15 luxury cars, from supercars and hypercars to a big luxury SUV and a formula racing car.
• Two cars in Sheru Bhai's own designs: a white, black and gold lion hypercar and a diamond-and-gold supercar.
• Ride superbikes, and fly fighter jets, a big jet, a propeller plane and a helicopter.
• Call any vehicle from your phone and drive anywhere on the island.
• Visit the luxury car showroom, where a gold racing car turns on its stand.

An Island to Explore
• Roam a big open island: highways and hill roads, an airport, sandy beaches and a beach island, a village, a stadium, a police station and more.
• Day, night, clouds and rain: let the weather change by itself, or pick the one you like in Settings.
• Cause trouble, like blowing up cars, and police cars will come after you.

Your Royal Phone
A gold-and-ivory phone with your own apps:
• Vehicle: call cars, bikes and aircraft.
• Weapon: pick your weapons and change their colours.
• Bank: see Sheru Bhai's royal fortune.
• Camera: take photos and selfies anywhere on the island.

Play Your Way
• Simple touch controls to walk, run, drive and fly.
• Play offline: no internet needed.
• No sign-up and no account.

Live like a king and drive like a legend. Become Sheru Bhai!

apps.title: Wolf War: Last Survival
apps.summary:
Explore the world of wolves and embark on a brutal journey of survival and battle amid the conflicts of rival packs. Lead your packmates and allies into fierce clashes against powerful enemies. As the tribe’s last orphan—and its final hope, you must strengthen yourself, recruit formidable wolf heroes, and evolve them into powerful allies ready to face the most terrifying foes.

Key Features:

- RPG Combat
Every bite, claw, and strike matters. Gather resources, strengthen your wolf pack, expand your territory, and conquer the wolf lands.

- Recruit & Research
Recruit and unlock different types of wolf heroes for your pack and unleash their full potential. Each wolf hero adds tactical depth to every fight, raising your odds of victory in every battle.

- Hunt & Evolve
Empower your wolf heroes through multiple upgrade and evolution paths to control the battlefield. Grow stronger is the key to surviving high-intensity clashes.

- Alliance & Conquest
Enter a wild world filled with adventure and mystery. Uncover the secrets of the packs, meet wolves of many kinds, and stand together against overwhelming threats. The pack's survival war is full of challenges—and rich rewards.

Join Wolf War: Last Survival, explore the world of the wolf packs, plunge into the wolf war, and become the strongest alpha. The wild shows no mercy. Lead with fangs and fury.

apps.title: QB Clash: Quarterback Football
apps.summary:
QB Clash is an American football passing game played in 1v1 duels. Each duel has three rounds: deep, mid and red zone. You and your opponent throw on the same plays, against the same defense and wind, and the higher score wins.

• Pull back to aim, hold still until the ring tightens, then let go.
• Catches are graded for placement: On target, Dime or Pinpoint. Yards in the air, yards after the catch, contested catches, tight spirals and touchdowns all add to your score.
• See the routes before the snap, read the defense and adjust for wind.
• Win duels to earn trophies and coins, and unlock 10 gridiron stadiums, from Sandlot Park and Campus Bowl to the Championship Dome. Higher stadiums add new plays and defenses.
• Collect and upgrade quarterback and receiver cards to improve arm, accuracy, release, speed and hands.
• Customize your team's city, name, jersey, helmet and logo, and pick your touchdown dances.
• Play in weekly leagues for prizes, and take on the Money Shot challenge on weekends for coins, gems and more.

apps.title: Pure Crime: Gangster City RP
apps.summary:
Rule the Streets. Live Your Way.
Enter the world of Pure Crime, an open-world gangster action adventure where crime, cars and chaos are all part of everyday life. Explore a huge city, build your Reputation and rise from small-time crook to the most feared name on the streets!

Make the city your playground in an open world full of action and opportunity. Steal cars, battle rival gangs, escape intense police chases and free roam however you like. Race through traffic, take on jobs, earn cash and discover new ways to get ahead. Whether you're causing chaos or making an honest living, every hustle brings you closer to the top.

Dive into urban crime in this action game. Take on gangs, mobsters and mafia crews in third-person shootouts and chase them down in fast cars. Every choice shapes your story in the city.

Build your Reputation and unlock the city! Complete Activities, take on rivals and cause chaos to earn Reputation, level up and unlock new jobs, powerful weapons, incredible vehicles, new outfits, player housing and entire districts. The more you play, the more opportunities open up, with new places to explore and bigger rewards to chase!

Want some action? Grab a weapon, steal a car and take on the streets. Fancy something different? Race through the city, drive a taxi, deliver pizzas or discover another way to make cash. In Pure Crime, there's always something happening and a new way to build your legend.

Key Features
• Open-World Crime Sandbox - Explore a city packed with action, danger and opportunity. Free roam wherever you want, cause chaos and find your own way to the top.
• Third-Person Shooter Action - Fight your rivals in fast gunfights and shootouts across the city.
• Build Your Reputation - Earn Reputation through Activities, combat and open-world chaos. Level up to unlock new cars, weapons, outfits, jobs, housing and districts.
• Crime, Gangs and Police Chases - Battle rival gangs, steal vehicles and escape the law as your Wanted Level rises.
• Jobs, Races and Activities - Take on street races, taxi driving, deliveries, wanted targets and more. Every Activity offers a new way to earn rewards.
• Cars, Bikes, Helicopters and More! - Drive, steal and collect vehicles, from everyday rides to high-performance cars and special vehicles.
• Weapons, Shooting and Customisation - Collect and upgrade weapons, unlock new looks and create your own style.
• Unlock New Districts and Homes - Rise through the Reputation ranks to unlock new areas of the city, claim new homes and expand your world.
• PvP and Clans - Take on other players in competitive battles, team up in a clan and climb the leaderboards.
• Regular Updates - New Activities, vehicles, weapons and features keep the world of Pure Crime growing.

Build your Reputation. Own the streets. Become a legend.
Download Pure Crime, the open-world gangster RP game, and start your rise to the top!

Note: Internet connection required to play.

· You enjoy everyday mysteries with no crime scenes or culprits

· You want to deduce with your own head, not just read along

apps.title: Gloamguard
apps.summary:
At dusk the Gloam rolls over Mirefield and the dead get up. One war wagon still holds the road. Keep it whole.

Gloamguard is a side-on lane defense game in a grim medieval land. Valor fills on its own and sends fighters off the wagon. Every kill feeds Wrath, which drops casks on the road. Break the bone barricade before the Gloamed break the wagon, then spend your silver and march on.

THREE ACTS, THIRTY MISSIONS
Start in the Fields with Tam, a peasant with a pitchfork, and a plain cart with one lantern. Cross Saint Odo's Lands, where more of the dead are spirits. End on the Corpse Road, at the abbey door, where the Plague Abbot raises his wards.

WHAT YOU DO
• Send six fighters down the road: Tam's pitchfork, Old Hobb's sling, Wat's maul, Rudd's axe, Sister Agna's slowing shot, Hale's torch
• Drop oak casks to crush the dead, pitch casks to burn them, a healer's satchel to keep your line standing
• Tap fallen standards for Valor; keep the wagon untouched for all three sigils
• Raise the war wagon through ten levels, from a plain cart to an iron-clad hood
• From Mission 20, a scorpion on its roof (level 8) looses a volley at full Wrath
• Level your fighters with silver and training writs; climb ten Renown ranks
• Meet eight kinds of Gloamed, from the howling Gloamrunner to the Wailing widow, who breaks fighters' nerve

THE MIST AND THE STORY
Burn lamp oil to clear the map's mist: it hides caches, four side quests and the Toll House, a trial in three levels. Twelve scenes play out on the road before their fights, from fighters joining the company to a bell ringing in an empty tower. The Gloamed book keeps a page for each kind of dead you meet.

NOTHING TO BUY
Lamp oil lights the way: a battle takes 2 and a misty tile takes 1. The tank holds 20 and refills a drop every 10 minutes, even while the game is closed, and each Renown rank fills it again. There is no shop and no oil for sale. A defeat costs nothing more: the Defeat screen names the upgrade you are missing and takes you to it. Stuck? Replay an earlier mission for silver and Renown, train, come back.

HOW IT PLAYS
Battles take a few minutes, in landscape, with taps and one drag. Dunstan, the old crossbowman on the wagon's roof, shoots on his own and teaches each new thing once.

GOOD TO KNOW
No ads and no in-app purchases. Battles need no internet connection. The game uses analytics to see how missions play; in the EU, EEA, UK and Switzerland it asks for consent first. Progress stays on your device. English only.

apps.title: Turbo Slope
apps.summary:
One push, one long slope and a lot of snow. How far can your sled go?

Every run starts at the top of the hill. You let go, pick up speed on the downhill drop, catch air off the ramps and try to make it over the next crest. Didn't make it? Fine. Take the coins you earned, upgrade your sled and go again. Each run gets you a little further than the last, and that's exactly where this sled game gets you.

WHAT YOU DO
• Slide down steep winter slopes and fly off kickers, humps and snow ramps, a proper ramp jump every time
• Steer through green speed gates and stay away from the red ones that slow you down
• Dodge skiers, rolling snowballs and trees, or jump on the rails for a bit of style
• Upgrade your launch, glide and more to beat the hill that stopped you last time, the way a good upgrade game should work
• Reach the finish line, grab your diamonds and head to a longer, tougher level

PLACES TO RIDE
Start in the mountains with a big first drop and sharp crests that decide everything. Then move on to the Frozen Lakes, wide open ice where you can glide for ages if you bring enough speed. Real physics game feel: every bump, landing and slope changes your run. More spots for fans of winter games are coming.

RIDERS AND SKINS
Open chests to unlock new riders and sled skins. Santa is in there too, so it turns into a little Christmas game whenever you want, all year round.

EASY TO PICK UP
One finger to steer, short runs and progress you can feel after every try. A simple casual game for a quick five minute break, and just as good for a longer evening of "okay, one more run". Old school arcade game vibes, modern snow.

If you like sledding, snow racing, any jump game with big air or a relaxing sliding game where every run counts, Turbo Slope should feel like home. It's a snow game without complicated controls or long tutorials. Just you, the sled and the hill.

See you at the bottom.

apps.title: Wordsect - Word Puzzle Games
apps.summary:
Wordsect combines crossword puzzles with connected letter tiles and satisfying tile breaks. Find words on the letter board, fill the crossword grid, and plan which tiles to use next.

The numbers change how you play. Each tile has a limited number of uses, shown on its face. Use a tile to form a word and its count goes down. When the count reaches zero, it cracks and crumbles. A word that fits now may use letters you need later, so look beyond your next answer.

HOW TO PLAY
- Connect neighboring letters up, down, left, or right to form words.
- Find words that fit the crossword grid.
- Check the numbers to track each tile's remaining uses.
- Watch a tile break apart when its count reaches zero.

CROSSWORDS WITH AN EXTRA CHALLENGE
Solving the crossword is only part of the puzzle. Explore letter paths and consider how each word affects the tiles still available. Put vocabulary, spelling, and planning together as you work towards a completed grid.

A SATISFYING WAY TO FIND WORDS
Letter tiles crack and crumble when they are used up, giving each puzzle a distinctive visual rhythm. Enjoy the word-finding challenge and the satisfying break-apart moments along the way.

LARGE LETTERS, READABLE COUNTS
See the letters and remaining-use numbers clearly as you study the board. Compare possible connections, choose a word, and make your next move.

If you enjoy crossword games and connecting letters, try a word puzzle where finding an answer and choosing a path go hand in hand.

Welcome to Arrow Story: Home Design! A relaxing arrow puzzle game that trains your brain.
SOS! A woman and her dog lost their home to a fire. A family is caught in a blizzard. They need your help.
Come to Arrow Story: Home Design. Solve arrow puzzles, collect stars, and help people in need rebuild their homes and get back to happy lives.
It's a heartfelt arrow puzzle game where every level brings a change you can see. Spend the stars you earn to repair their broken homes until the place looks new again. One repair at a time, you put their lives back together.

Arrows cover every grid, and each one can only travel the way it points. That means one arrow can block another. Study the layout, spot which arrows are in the way, and find the order that clears the board.

Hard and super-hard levels put your planning to the test.

• ⭐ Arrow puzzles with a real payoff: every grid you clear pays stars
• 🔨 Builds you can see: every repair brings the place closer to new, and helps someone who needs it

apps.title: Hidden Christmas: Find Objects
apps.summary:
Search festive pictures and find hidden objects in Hidden Christmas: Find Objects. Zoom into snowy villages, cozy cabins, and decorated homes, then tap each item on your list. No timer. Play at your own pace.

🎄 How to play
Each scene shows the objects you need to find. Pinch to zoom, drag across the picture, and tap what you spot. Some items sit in plain sight. Others blend into the lights, gifts, and furniture, so the fun is in looking twice. If you get stuck, use a hint and keep going.

A round is simple. Open a Christmas picture, check the list, and search until every object is found. Larger items help you settle in. Smaller ones ask for a closer look. When the list is clear, move on to the next scene. Nothing is counting down while you search.

🎅 Christmas scenes to explore
Move through snowy villages, Christmas workshops, gift-filled rooms, glowing streets, and warm living rooms. You will see sparkling trees, snowy rooftops, festive windows, and rooms full of holiday color.

The pictures are not copies of one living room. A quiet cabin, a busy workshop, a decorated dining room, and a street lined with lights each hide objects in different places. The clutter, the colors, and the corners worth checking all change.

🎁 What you will find
Look for the details that make a scene feel like Christmas: ornaments, wrapped presents, candy canes, stockings, bells, wreaths, gingerbread, and snowflakes. Santa, elves, reindeer, and snowmen show up among the garlands, along with mittens, scarves, snow globes, and pine trees.

Check the mantel, the table, the windowsill, and the edge of the room. Holiday objects sit inside the picture, mixed in with decorations, furniture, and wrapped gifts.

❄️ A calm Christmas hidden object game
Hidden Christmas is a relaxing seek-and-find game for a short break or a longer cozy session. Finish one list, then come back later for another winter scene.

It is an easy holiday puzzle when you want something festive without a timer, and a closer search when you feel like examining every corner. Play for a few minutes, or stay with a picture until the last object turns up.

If you like Christmas games, hidden object puzzles, and holiday seek-and-find pictures, start with one scene and see what you notice.

apps.title: Factifact: Trivia Word Puzzle
apps.summary:
Factifact is a trivia word puzzle that turns fun facts into wordplay. 🔍 Each short fact hides some of its words inside brackets. Read the definitions, find the missing words and reveal the whole fact.

How does a Factifact word game work? A fact appears with some words, or parts of words, hidden in brackets. Each bracket holds a short definition of a missing word. Read it and guess the word from four options. No typing is needed, so these logic puzzles stay smooth and focused. Definitions are nested three or four layers deep. The answer to an inner definition becomes a word in the outer one. It feels like trivia questions stacked inside each other. Every word you find brings you closer to interesting facts about the world. 🧠 Think of them as word riddles that test your vocabulary.

Factifact works like a reverse crossword without a grid. ⛏️ Classic crossword puzzles give you a clue and a row of empty squares. Here you start from the clue and dig down to the hidden word. Fans of word puzzle games will feel at home right away. Every brainteaser blends vocabulary, reasoning and general knowledge in one sequence. Short brain teasers like these make a calm mental workout at any time.

Guess the word correctly and the next layer of the puzzle opens. Unlike most word quiz games, every answer becomes part of the next clue. These trivia questions reward careful reading and patient thinking. Solving puzzles here feels like piecing a small story together. What you will find inside:
💡 A hint when a clue feels too tricky
❤️ Three hearts per fact, so every guess counts
🏺 A dig site that uncovers a hidden find with each solved word
📌 A board where every solved fact is pinned as a colorful note
🎉 Confetti, fireworks and kind words when a fact is fully revealed

The facts cover nature, geography, animals and much more. 🏺 One puzzle explains why honey can stay fresh for centuries. Another shows how Mount Everest is still growing. If you enjoy crossword puzzles, these little discoveries will surprise you. Factifact brings word puzzle games and general knowledge together. Expect brain teasers that are short, fair and satisfying to crack.

Facts unlock one after another, and any solved fact can be reread later. 📌 Some logic puzzles are gentle, while others are real brainteasers with deep nesting. A wrong answer costs a heart, so read each clue carefully. Love word quiz games, solving puzzles and interesting facts? 🎉 Factifact is waiting for you.

apps.title: SoEasy Mahjong 2: Make Ten
apps.summary:
Ready for a new kind of Mahjong puzzle? 🀄

SoEasy Mahjong 2: Make Ten combines classic Mahjong tile matching with a fun number puzzle twist. Match identical tiles, pair special tiles, or combine number tiles to make 10. Find the right matches, clear the board, and enjoy a fresh puzzle experience with every level.

Mahjong Matching with a Twist

Discover more ways to match and clear tiles:

• Match Identical Tiles — Find two tiles with the same design and clear the pair.

• Make 10 — Combine two number tiles that add up to 10, such as 8 + 2, 6 + 4, or 7 + 3.

• Match Special Tiles — Spot themed tiles and pair matching designs to clear the board.

Each board offers different matching opportunities. Look carefully, choose your next move, and find the best way to clear the tiles. 🔍

Easy to Learn, Fun to Solve

Enjoy the familiar look of Mahjong tiles with a fresh tile-matching puzzle mechanic. Whether you prefer spotting identical tiles or finding number pairs that add up to 10, every move gives you a new way to approach the board.

The rules are simple to understand, but finding the right matches takes observation and planning. Think ahead, explore different combinations, and enjoy the satisfaction of clearing tiles one pair at a time.

How to Play

• Find tiles that can be matched.
• Pair identical Mahjong tiles or matching special tiles.
• Combine two number tiles that add up to 10.
• Choose your matches carefully to clear the board.
• Complete each puzzle by clearing the tiles.

Match, Think & Relax 🍃

Looking for a relaxing Mahjong puzzle, a casual tile-matching game, or a fun number puzzle? SoEasy Mahjong 2 brings them together in one easy-to-play experience.

Enjoy familiar Mahjong-style tiles, satisfying matches, and the added challenge of making 10. Take your time, find the right combinations, and clear each board at your own pace.

Start your Mahjong puzzle journey today and see how far you can go! 🎯

apps.summary:
Letterlight is a cozy word search where every puzzle you solve switches on a light in a little town.

Swipe across the letters to find each hidden word: across, down, backwards or diagonally. Clear a level and another lantern, window or string of lights starts to glow. Ten levels light up a whole town, then you travel on to the next one.

50 COZY TOWNS TO LIGHT
Wander from a cozy kitchen to a seaside harbour, a bookshop lane, a blossom street, a moon base and a treehouse village. 500 levels in all, each with its own themed words.

PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE
There are no level timers and nothing to lose. Leave a puzzle halfway and pick it up later. Letterlight plays offline, too.

A NEW PUZZLE EVERY DAY
Solve the daily puzzle to keep your streak glowing and earn a trophy for each month.

JOIN THE LANTERN RACE
Race four neighbours to clear 10 levels first and win coins and boosters.

A LITTLE HELP WHEN YOU'RE STUCK
A Hint shows the first letter of a word. The Wand finds a whole word for you. The Lantern lights the first letter of every word for a moment.

SEASONAL TOWNS
Holiday towns visit for a short while, with their own words to find.

EXTRA JOYS
Spot secret words for bonus coins, collect every town in your album, and unlock achievements as you go.

Letterlight is free to play. It includes optional in-app purchases and ads, and a one-time No Ads purchase.

apps.title: Transformers: Eternal War
apps.summary:
Autobots and Decepticons stand united against the Chaos Legion! Experience an all-new Transformers Strategy Idle RPG featuring an original story by Simon Furman!

The Earth has been consumed by a mysterious force born from pure chaos energy—an unstoppable corruption now spreading toward humanity’s final line of defense.
For generations, Autobots and Decepticons have waged an unrelenting war. But in the face of the Chaos Legion—as heroes and villains fight against the chaos—old enmities must be set aside.
The fight for Earth is no longer about victory. It is about survival.

◆ Forge an Original Transformers Epic with Simon Furman ◆
Transformers: Eternal War features an original story written by Simon Furman, the legendary writer who helped define the Transformers universe for generations of fans.
In this all-new chapter, players will uncover the rise of the Chaos Legion, an apocalyptic faction empowered by unstable chaos energy. As its influence spreads, iconic Autobots and Decepticons must unite against a corruption threatening Earth, Cybertron, and the future of the universe.
Faced with a threat unlike anything they have ever encountered, Autobots and Decepticons must confront an impossible choice: continue their endless war—or stand together to protect Earth, Cybertron, and the future of all they fight for.

◆ Lead the Combat Through Strategic Command ◆
Transformers: Eternal War evolves the character-collector experience with a streamlined system focused on tactical squad-building and strategic progression over constant micromanagement.
Whether online or away from the battlefield, your forces continue fighting, gathering resources, and advancing the war effort around the clock. Recruit, upgrade, and command an ever-expanding roster of iconic Transformers while assembling powerful team synergies capable of turning the tide of battle.
Every squad composition matters. Every commander shapes the future of the conflict.

◆ Build the Ark. Sustain the Battle. ◆
Beyond the battlefield, players can expand and manage support facilities surrounding the Ark, creating a steady flow of resources that keeps their forces combat-ready at all times.
By upgrading automated production systems and optimizing resource operations, commanders can continuously strengthen their squads. Even while offline, your facilities remain active—gathering supplies, supporting troop growth, and preparing your forces for the next conflict.
Designed around a seamless hands-off experience, Transformers: Eternal War allows players to focus less on repetitive maintenance and more on assembling powerful teams, developing strategy, and pushing back against the growing Chaos Legion threat.

◆ A New Era of Transformers Warfare Begins ◆
Combining legendary characters, an original story crafted by one of the franchise’s most iconic writers, and a modern strategic gameplay experience built for mobile, Transformers: Eternal War delivers both a celebration of Transformers history and a bold new evolution for the franchise.

——The universe is changing.
——The signal has been broadcast.
——Now the fate of Earth depends on who answers the call！

apps.summary:
Keep the Last Light Lit Till Dawn.
Beneath a dying sky, the Old Gods stir and cursed hordes draw near. In Lit Till Dawn, you are the keeper of the final flame. Keep it burning, hold your ground, and live to see the dawn.
Lit Till Dawn blends gothic bullet-storm action, roguelike progression, and tower defense strategy. Face relentless enemy waves, defend your position, and craft a build strong enough to outlast the night.
Every wave brings a new choice. Pick a cursed weapon, strengthen your defenses, and chain powerful effects to turn the tide. Unleash the Ghost Wheel, send the Doom Carpet Roll tearing through enemy ranks, or punish approaching horrors with the Thorn Whip.
No two runs play alike. Adapt your build and choose between raw damage, critical chance, cooldown reduction, or defensive control. Collect forbidden relics, combine your gear, and forge a survival strategy that fits your playstyle.
Venture into haunted stages like the Rotting City, where nightmares born of sleeping gods await. Take on Normal, Heroic, or Mythic difficulty and push your exorcist's power to its limits.
Between battles, open the AFK Chest for coins, gems, relics, and other cursed treasures. Gather your rewards and prepare for the next wave.
Darkness spreads. The final flame flickers.
Stay lit. Hold the line. Last till dawn.

apps.title: The Last Walk: Survival Story
apps.summary:
The Last Walk is a zombie survival story game with real choices, set in a post-apocalyptic world. The army is evacuating the last civilians. Your wife and daughter climb onto the last truck. There is no room for you.

So you walk. Through dead suburbs, empty highways and burnt-out towns, all the way to the coast, across the sea, onto an island under siege, and beyond. More than 30 days of walking through a world overrun by zombies, and the story isn't over yet.

EVERY ENCOUNTER IS A CHOICE
A wounded stranger begs for a bandage. A lost child is starving. Raiders block the road. A bear escaped from the zoo sleeps across your path. A supermarket hands out free food, a little too freely. Swipe left or right: help or walk away, fight or run, trust or lie. Every choice changes your supplies, your health and the man you become.

SURVIVE THE ROAD
- Manage water, food and health: the road drains them every hour.
- Search the ruins, then buy and sell gear at the traders and markets.
- Arm yourself: nail bat, crowbar, machete, revolver, pump shotgun. Upgrade and reload them at the traders.
- Find a shelter before nightfall, or spend the night outside and fight the zombies, the Prowlers, until dawn.
- Meet people who walk with you for a while, and a stray dog who could change everything.

A FATHER'S STORY
Your family is alive, somewhere ahead. Keep your humanity or keep everything for yourself: the people you help, the ones you leave behind and the risks you take decide where your story goes.

MORE STORIES IN THE SAME WORLD
Other survivors walk other roads. Their stories take place in the same world and cross the main story. Unlock them by playing the main story or by paying.

FEATURES
- A zombie survival game and an interactive story, with real choices and no right answer
- More than 30 days of walking, and the story continues
- Several more stories to unlock by playing the main story or by paying
- Night fights, markets, weapons to upgrade and supplies to manage
- A side-scrolling pixel-art world with animated scenes
- Free to play, in short sessions
- Available in 31 languages

apps.title: Krakion: Krill Word Trivia
apps.summary:
Seven questions. One ocean. How deep can your knowledge take you?

Krakion is a daily trivia and word game where a correct answer is only the beginning. Each prompt has many possible answers. Your challenge is to find one other players might overlook. The rarer your answer, the more points you earn and the deeper you dive.

A QUICK QUIZ WITH A TWIST
Take on seven prompts with 25 seconds to answer each one. Type your own answers, think fast, and make every round count. Each point takes you 10 meters deeper, and a perfect dive reaches 7,000 meters.

DAILY CHALLENGE & UNLIMITED PLAY
Play the same seven prompts as everyone else, then come back for a fresh challenge tomorrow. Still have a krillion answers up your sleeve? Jump into Unlimited mode for another seven-question dive anytime.

FIND YOUR ONE-IN-A-KRILLION ANSWER
Discover six answer tiers, from everyday Plankton to Rare, Deep Cut, and One in a Krillion. After each dive, browse the accepted answers and see which ones you missed.

BUILD YOUR DIVING HABIT
Track your daily streak, completed dives, best score, and recent results. Keep your streak going to unlock new dive buddies. Share a spoiler-free scorecard so friends can try the questions for themselves.

MADE FOR CURIOUS MINDS
Explore a pixel-art ocean with playful sea creatures, sound effects, and options for reduced motion and colorblind-friendly colors. Krakion recognizes alternate names and minor typos, and AI helps check answers beyond the prepared lists.

Bring your general knowledge, think fast, and dig a little deeper. Your next answer could be one in a krillion.

apps.title: Dynasty Bowl: Retro Football
apps.summary:
Call the play. Make the throw. Build a dynasty.

Dynasty Bowl is a retro American football game in pixel art, with the depth of a football management sim behind every snap. Play quarterback on the field, run the franchise as head coach and general manager, or live a whole football career from high school football to college football to the pros. It plays offline, so no wifi is needed.

ARCADE FOOTBALL ON THE FIELD
• Fast, simple touch controls: drag to throw a pass, steer your running back and break the big run
• A classic sideline camera, or a behind-the-quarterback view with two-thumb controls
• Touchdowns, field goals and goal-line stands in rain, snow and night games under the lights
• Play every snap, only the key downs, or sim ahead whenever you like
• Quick games, practice and tournaments when you just want to play some football

FRANCHISE MODE: COACH, GM AND OWNER
• Draft rookies, sign free agents, make trades and set your depth chart
• Grow young players into superstars and manage every contract on a budget
• Answer to your owner: win, keep the books healthy, or start looking for a new job
• Rivalries, storylines, press conferences and a football league that remembers its history
• Seasons, playoffs and championships, with records, awards and the Hall of Fame

CAREER MODE: HIGH SCHOOL TO HALL OF FAME
• Start as a high school senior, a college freshman or a pro draft pick
• Get recruited, earn your starts on Friday nights and Saturdays, and hear your name on draft day
• One connected world: today's college football stars are tomorrow's draft class
• More than 19,000 high schools and 136 college programs

A RETRO SPORTS GAME WITH REAL DEPTH
Dynasty Bowl is for anyone who grew up on 8-bit and 16-bit sports games and wants a football sim they can play in a few minutes or for a hundred seasons. Coach your team to a title, build a dynasty that lasts decades, or take one quarterback from his first varsity snap to the Hall of Fame.

FREE TO PLAY
• All of the football is free
• Dynasty Bowl Pro is a one-time unlock: hire your own coaches, run your facilities, scouting points every season, the team editor for helmets and uniforms, commissioner mode, league rules and more save slots, with no full-screen ads
• Earn credits by playing or by watching an ad, or pick some up in the store, for scouting reports and coach hires

Your dynasty starts with the next snap.

apps.summary:
Take the map, commander! Frontline is a real time territory war on real maps of Europe, where every border is a neon front line.

LAND AND EXPAND
Pick your landing zone, spread into neutral land and cross the sea by boat. Every city you take grows your army and your income.

Frontline is free to play. It contains optional in-app purchases and ads.

Bring order to a tangled board in Rope Sort, a relaxing color sorting puzzle game where you arrange vibrant flowers and sparkling jewels onto matching ropes!

apps.title: Bingo Rise
apps.summary:
Bingo Rise is designed for people who find regular alarms too easy to ignore.
If you often hit snooze, turn alarms off half awake, or fall back asleep after a quick tap, Bingo Rise is built to make mornings more active. Instead of relying only on a standard stop button, the app lets you clear your alarm through a Bingo challenge, adding a small but meaningful task before the sound ends.

The goal is not to make wake-ups complicated. It is to make them harder to dismiss without thinking. A short Bingo round gives you a moment of focus, a reason to interact, and a better chance of getting fully awake before going back to sleep.
Bingo Rise is especially suited for people who need a stronger morning routine but still want something simple and enjoyable to use. The Bingo element makes the experience feel lighter and more playful than a harsh alarm, while still helping you get out of bed on time.

With Bingo Rise, you can:
- Create alarms for mornings, naps, routines, and reminders
- Choose one-time alarms or repeating schedules
- Set your preferred ringtone and vibration options
- Dismiss alarms normally or with a Bingo challenge
- Pick different Bingo challenge levels for different wake-up needs
- Manage everything in a clean and easy-to-use layout

Bingo Rise is designed for lazy mornings, heavy sleepers, and anyone who needs a little more help getting started. It turns alarm dismissal into a quick Bingo moment, so waking up feels more engaging, more effective, and a lot less automatic.

SAND HOLE: BLOCK SORT JAM – SORT COLORS, FILL BLOCKS, SOLVE PUZZLES

Sand Hole: Block Sort Jam is a satisfying color sort puzzle with flowing colored sand and clever block sorting challenges. Drag color blocks toward matching sand, fill each block to 100%, and clear the board. Every sand puzzle combines color matching, spatial reasoning, and smart planning.

HOW TO PLAY

Each level has framed panels of colored sand and a board of differently shaped blocks. Use one finger to drag blocks across the board. When a block touches sand of the same color, it absorbs the grains until it is full.

• Drag blocks toward matching colors to collect sand.
• Fill blocks to 100% to make them pop off the board.
• Clear all the sand to complete the level.
• Plan the order of moves: blocks cannot pass through each other.
• Study the layout before moving. The timer starts with your first move.

This block sort puzzle is easy to control but takes strategy to master. Choose which block to fill first to open space for the next one.

REAL SAND PHYSICS, SATISFYING COLOR SORTING

The king will fall. His fortune won't.

King Dies Rich is a pixel-art roguelike tower defense where the king himself is the tower. Hold the throne against the undead, find powerful loot, and turn every defeat into a stronger kingdom: castle defense, roguelite, and RPG in one game.

HOLD THE THRONE
Your king stays on his throne as enemies close in from every side. Slide a finger to guide the attack circle while he strikes automatically. Pick the most dangerous targets, break up the horde, and survive the next boss. Choose drag or direct touch aiming to suit your play style.

SEVEN SCHOOLS OF POWER
Shape your build with Fire, Frost, Poison, Lightning, Guard, Blades, and Spirits. Burn the undead, freeze a crowd, unleash chain lightning, or surround the throne with blades and spirit archers. LOOT, EQUIP, REFORGE

DEEPER HALLS, DEADLIER BOSSES

apps.title: SCRAM: Hide and Seek
apps.summary:
SCRAM is hide and seek for the real world. Split into hunters and runners, start the clock, and play across your street, park, campus or campsite, with your phone keeping score.

HOW IT WORKS
• Runners get a head start to hide.
• Every few minutes the hunters get a ping: each runner's location pops up on their map, marked with how long ago it was.
• Each team sees its own players live. Between pings the hunters are guessing, and runners never see hunters at all.
• Stray outside the play zone and, after 30 seconds, the hunters can see you live until you're back in.
• Tag someone in person and they tap "I got tagged". Last runners standing when time runs out win.

YOU SET THE RULES
The host picks the round length, the head start, how often the pings come (or none at all), and the play zone: its size, where it sits, and how often it shrinks. Or switch the zone off and play anywhere. Everyone joins with a six-character game code.

MADE FOR PLAYING OUTSIDE
• Alerts reach you with your phone locked: pings, the head start ending, the zone shrinking, and tags.
• Radio keeps each team talking without the other team listening.
• Alerts buzz instead of ring, so they won't give away where you're hiding.

YOUR LOCATION, ONLY WHEN IT COUNTS
SCRAM shares your location only during a round, and only with the players in your game. Games are private and need their code to join, and they're deleted after seven days.

FREE TO JOIN
Downloading SCRAM and joining games is free. Hosting your own games is a one-time purchase: no subscription and no ads.

Play somewhere safe, keep an eye on traffic, and stay off private property.

Morning Arrows is built to be easy to use every day while giving you more control over how strong or active your wake-up routine should feel.

- Set multiple alarms for different parts of your day
- Use one-time alarms or repeat by weekday
- Choose ringtone and vibration settings
- Stop alarms normally or with an arrow task
- Use different arrow task levels depending on your routine
- Manage everything in a clear, simple layout

Why people use it
- Standard alarms are too easy to dismiss
- Snoozing turns into oversleeping
- A small task helps them wake up more fully
- They want a stronger alarm without a confusing setup
✅ If you need something more effective than a basic alarm clock, Morning Arrows gives you a more active way to wake up and stay on schedule.

apps.title: Rat Raid: Zombie Plague
apps.summary:
🐀 Rat Raid: Zombie Defense Strategy is an idle survival shooter and one of the most strategic rat games, where you lead the tower defense against the mutant rat invasion. Fight waves of mutant pests, build shooting turrets, harvest crops and craft weapons: it mixes rat games, defense games, shooting games and idle survival strategy, and you grow stronger with every raid.

Molly returns to the village where she spent a happy childhood, ready to bring the land she loves back to life. Toxic waste has started a mutant rat plague, but with smart turrets and a brave heart she can win. Only a true hero can stop it and save the village.

🔫 FIGHT THE MUTANT RAT INVASION
Aim, shoot and hit hard in real-time survival shooter combat. Face shielded brutes, dynamite carriers, ranged attackers and giant mutant bosses. Raids grow bigger and meaner, so keep moving, reload your guns and let your turrets defend the flanks. Fans of shooting games and rat games will feel right at home.

🛡️ PLACE TURRETS AND DEFEND THE VILLAGE!
Build turrets from anything you find: a pumpkin catapult, a corn minigun, a flamethrower scarecrow or a shotgun on a turret base. Place them wisely and turn your fields into a tower defense battlefield. Each turret counters a different enemy, so smart placement and upgrades decide the base defense. Like in classic tower defense, planning wins the battle.

⚔️ EVERY WAVE IS DIFFERENT
Unlike in most rat games, the mutant rat invasion keeps changing. Shield bearers soak up damage, bombers blast holes in your lines, ranged attackers hit from a distance and bosses can break a weak flank alone. Study each wave and pick the right turret before the horde arrives.

⚒️ SMASH, CRAFT, UPGRADE
Smash crates, fences and junk to collect resources, then craft weapons and tools at the workbench. Upgrade your gun, hammer and scythe in a simple survival craft loop and build a true killer arsenal, ready for the next fight.

🌾 GROW, HARVEST AND TRADE.
Between fights, it is harvest time: plant crops, harvest them with your scythe and turn the harvest into products that pay for weapons and turrets. Sell goods at your market stall, unlock new fields and turn your homestead into a fortified base for the home defense.

♟️ IDLE DEFENSE STRATEGY
Upgrades, harvests and turrets keep your firepower growing between waves, giving your base the steady progression of idle tower defense and idle survival. Build, collect and upgrade at your own pace, even offline, and come back stronger for the next wave of the mutant invasion.

☣️ UNCOVER THE AMBRIE CORP MYSTERY
Read notes, rescue survivors who join your camp and follow the quest book chapters to find out who poisoned the land and started it all. Chapters bring fresh locations, tougher mutants and answers about the toxic disaster.

🎮 GAME FEATURES
- Survival shooter action with Molly, a brave female hero
- Idle tower defense meets rat games: pumpkin, corn and scarecrow turrets
- A mutant invasion with shields, dynamite, ranged attacks and giant bosses
- Craft weapons and grow your arsenal
- Farm, harvest and trade to fund new turrets
- Story quests and the Ambrie Corp mystery
- Idle survival that plays fully offline, anywhere

🐁 One of the best rat games for fans of the base defense, idle survival and survival shooter action. Lead the turret defense, stop the mutant rat invasion, harvest your crops and survive every raid! Few rat games mix survival, farming and shooting like this, so join the fight today!

apps.title: Sort Streak: Color Puzzle
apps.summary:
🌸 SORT STREAK: COLOR PUZZLE 🌸

Sort, match, and arrange colorful flowers in a satisfying sorting puzzle adventure!

Sort Streak is a relaxing color sorting puzzle game and matching game that combines simple drag-and-drop gameplay with thoughtful planning. Colorful flowers are arranged on ropes, and your goal is to sort flowers by color, match them to the right rope, complete objectives, and fill flower pots.

The gameplay is easy to learn, but every move matters. Rearrange the flowers, manage limited rope space, and find the best solution for every puzzle level. Whether you want to relax or train your logical thinking, Sort Streak offers a colorful and satisfying puzzle challenge.

🎮 HOW TO PLAY

• Pick up a flower or a connected group of flowers from a rope.
• Drag the flowers onto an empty rope.
• You can also place them onto a rope with the same color at its free end and enough space.
• Sort and match flowers by color while carefully planning each move.
• Complete a full group of flowers on the matching rope.
• Watch the completed group collect into a flower pot.
• Complete all objectives and fill the required pots to clear the level.

Every move can change the entire board. Look ahead, rearrange the flowers, and use the available rope space wisely. If there are no legal moves left, the level ends. Can you overcome every sorting challenge and complete the objectives?

✨ WHY YOU’LL LOVE SORT STREAK

• Relaxing color sorting gameplay that is easy to learn.
• Simple drag-and-drop controls for an intuitive matching game experience.
• Colorful flowers, ropes, and satisfying sorting animations.
• Puzzle levels ranging from easy introductions to challenging arrangements.
• Different levels and layouts that keep the sorting adventure fresh.
• Helpful tools, including Hint, Undo, and Add a Rope.
• Satisfying flower grouping and flower pot collection feedback.
• A casual puzzle game for a quick break or a longer gameplay session.
• A fun way to practice logical thinking, spatial planning, and problem-solving.

🔮 SPECIAL PUZZLE MECHANICS

Mystery Flowers add surprise to your color sorting adventure. Move the flowers underneath to bring a Mystery Flower to the end of the rope and reveal its true color. Once revealed, the flower can be sorted and matched according to the color rules.

Locked Flowers create new obstacles and objectives. Locked flowers cannot be moved until you complete the required color objective or the required number of group objectives. Unlock new possibilities, rearrange the ropes, and find a way through each challenging puzzle level.

As you progress, the flower arrangements become more complex. You will need to read the flower order, overcome obstacles, manage limited space, and choose every move carefully.

🧠 SORT, MATCH, AND TRAIN YOUR BRAIN

Sort Streak gives you a peaceful break while encouraging logical thinking, spatial planning, and problem-solving. Take your time to sort colorful flowers, match the right colors, complete objectives, and enjoy the satisfying feeling of solving a puzzle.

Whether you enjoy sorting games, matching games, color sorting puzzles, brain teasers, or casual puzzle games, Sort Streak offers an easy-to-learn experience with satisfying challenges for every puzzle fan.

Can you sort every flower, overcome every obstacle, unlock every possibility, fill every flower pot, and solve every puzzle? 🌸

Start playing Sort Streak today and enjoy a colorful sorting puzzle adventure!

apps.title: Cinderella: Tile Story
apps.summary:
Can you help Cinderella reach the royal ball before the clock strikes midnight?

Every great tile match begins with a single tap. In Cinderella: Mahjong Tile, you’ll solve hundreds of clever mahjong puzzles, each one bringing you closer to the castle. This is more than an ordinary tile game – it’s a magical adventure where every match brings Cinderella closer to the royal castle.

How the magic works:
Tiles are stacked in layers, some face-down like a classic mahjong puzzle. Your goal: collect three identical tiles on a special rack with 7 slots. Each tap sends a tile to the rack. When three match, they disappear. Fill the rack with seven unmatched tiles, and you’ll have to try again. This easy-to-learn mechanic turns every level into a delightful brain teaser.

Along the way, discover exciting pin puzzle challenges. Use logic to pull the pin at the right moment, clear obstacles, and help Cinderella move safely through tricky situations. Every challenge requires careful timing and logical thinking, making the pin puzzles a fun addition to the tile-matching adventure.

Why players love this puzzle game:
👗 Guide Cinderella – unlock elegant gowns, royal accessories, and beautiful castle rooms.
🧠 Train your brain – each mahjong puzzle and pin puzzle challenge tests your memory, logic, and planning skills.
📌 Master every pin puzzle – figure out the right sequence and clear each challenge with perfect timing.
📴 Play offline – enjoy this puzzle game on the train, plane, or sofa without Wi-Fi.
🆓 Hundreds of free levels – from relaxing matches to challenging tile puzzles.
💡 Helpful hints – never feel stuck; a little magic always helps Cinderella.

Perfect for fans of triple-tile games, princess adventures, relaxing puzzles, and pin challenges. Every solved mahjong puzzle rewards you with progress toward the grand ball. The royal tile match gameplay is easy to learn but hard to master, while each pin puzzle adds another layer of brain-teasing fun.

Ready for more magic? Pull the pin carefully, match triple tiles, solve magical mahjong puzzles, and give Cinderella the happy ending she deserves. This puzzle game will keep you entertained for hours – offline, online, anytime. Join the adventure and discover what awaits beyond each challenge.

apps.title: Just a Squire
apps.summary:
You’re just a squire.

Do the chores. Earn your wages. Buy and merge powerful skills. Transform against impossible odds. Fall in love. And somehow… save the kingdom that ignored you.

All while everyone else gets the glory.

WELCOME TO JUST A SQUIRE

Just a Squire is a story-driven roguelite RPG about an underappreciated squire determined to prove that even the most ordinary person can become a hero.

Your adventure begins with simple duties and a knight who expects far too much. But when strange enemies appear and a mysterious power awakens within you, carrying the bags becomes the least of your problems.

TURN CHORES INTO GOLD

A squire’s work is never finished. At least this time, you’re getting paid.

Tackle playful timing and physics-based mini-games that turn everyday duties into satisfying challenges. Aim carefully, time your moves and earn gold for your hard work. Apparently, saving the kingdom doesn’t excuse you from chores.

BUY, MERGE AND CHOOSE YOUR SKILLS

Build your strategy as each chapter unfolds. Buy skills, merge them into stronger versions and choose combinations that work together.

Spend wisely, adapt to the skills on offer and decide which upgrades deserve your gold. Your next purchase could bring the whole build together.

UNLEASH YOUR TRANSFORMATIONS

Discover different Squire Forms and awaken powerful transformations at unforgettable story moments. Explore new looks, reveal the strength hiding inside you and show everyone what a “mere squire” can really do.

You might look a little different afterward. The chores will still be waiting.

MAKE YOUR SQUIRE YOUR OWN

Collect and upgrade equipment, try different combinations and give your squire a look worth remembering.

Discover Fate gear inspired by the different lives your squire could have lived. From humble jobs to distinctive clans, each look brings another possibility to your adventure. Apparently, being underappreciated comes in several outfits.

COLLECT PETS, MOUNTS AND SENTINELS

Expand your collection with charming pets, impressive mounts and powerful sentinels. Find your favorites and give your adventure a little more company.

Even a squire deserves someone on their side.

TAKE ON SOLO CHALLENGES AND PVP

Venture beyond the story with single-player modes and test your strength against other players in PvP battles.

Put your growing collection and carefully chosen upgrades to work across different challenges. Fight through beautiful fantasy arenas, face strange enemies and find more reasons to get stronger.

LIVE YOUR OWN FANTASY STORY

Meet memorable heroes, rivals, inventors, knights and monsters across unfolding chapters. Survive your knight’s increasingly ridiculous requests. Form unexpected friendships. Fall in love.

Uncover the truth behind a growing darkness and become the unlikely hero standing between the kingdom and an ancient evil.

You may begin as the least important person in the kingdom…

But you won’t stay that way for long.

Put your growing collection and carefully chosen upgrades to work across different challenges. Fight through beautiful fantasy arenas, face strange enemies and find more reasons to get stronger.

LIVE YOUR OWN FANTASY STORY

Meet memorable heroes, rivals, inventors, knights and monsters across unfolding chapters. Survive your knight’s increasingly ridiculous requests. Form unexpected friendships. Fall in love.

Uncover the truth behind a growing darkness and become the unlikely hero standing between the kingdom and an ancient evil.

You may begin as the least important person in the kingdom…

But you won’t stay that way for long.

apps.title: Projeto Grau 2
apps.summary:
Projeto Grau 2 é um jogo de grau de moto em uma cidade aberta, cheia de ruas, avenidas e caminhos para explorar.

Suba na moto, empine e mostre o seu controle: o grau responde ao acelerador, ao freio e ao seu equilíbrio, com manobras, quedas e muita adrenalina.

GRAU E MANOBRAS
• Empine a moto e segure o grau o máximo que conseguir
• Stoppie, borrachão, pé no chão e outras manobras
• Física de moto feita para o grau

CIDADE ABERTA
• Ande a pé, de moto ou de carro por toda a cidade
• Trânsito, semáforos, dia, noite e clima
• Minimapa com GPS para chegar a qualquer lugar

TRABALHE E GANHE DINHEIRO
• Entregas por aplicativo, fretes e encomendas
• Serviços de eletricista, lenhador e entrega de frutas
• Use o dinheiro do jogo para comprar novas motos e carros

GARAGEM E OFICINA
• Guarde seus veículos na garagem e escolha qual usar
• Troque rodas, pneus, suspensão, cambagem e pintura
• Monte um som automotivo no porta-malas
• Personalize as peças da moto com cores e imagens

MOTOS E CARROS
• Motos de rua e carros para comprar ou alugar
• Veja cada veículo em 3D antes de escolher

Jogo gratuito com anúncios. Os controles na tela podem ser ajustados nas configurações.

Atenção: Projeto Grau 2 é um jogo. Não repita as manobras no trânsito real. Use sempre equipamentos de segurança e respeite as leis de trânsito.
apps.description:
Project Grau 2 is a motorcycle stunt game set in an open city, full of streets, avenues, and paths to explore.

Get on your bike, pop a wheelie, and show off your control: the stunts respond to the throttle, brake, and your balance, with maneuvers, crashes, and plenty of adrenaline.

WHEELIES AND MANEUVERS
• Wheelie and hold the wheelie for as long as you can
• Stoppie, burnout, foot to the ground, and other maneuvers
• Motorcycle physics designed for wheelies

OPEN CITY
• Walk, ride a motorcycle, or drive throughout the city
• Traffic, traffic lights, day, night, and weather
• Minimap with GPS to get anywhere

WORK AND EARN MONEY
• App deliveries, freight, and packages
• Electrician, lumberjack, and fruit delivery services
• Use in-game money to buy new motorcycles and cars

GARAGE AND WORKSHOP
• Store your vehicles in the garage and choose which one to use
• Change wheels, tires, suspension, camber, and paint
• Install a car audio system in the trunk
• Customize motorcycle parts with colors and images

MOTORCYCLES AND CARS
• Street motorcycles and cars to buy or rent
• See each vehicle in 3D before choosing

Free game with Advertisements. On-screen controls can be adjusted in the settings.

Warning: Project Grade 2 is a game. Do not repeat the maneuvers in real traffic. Always use safety equipment and respect traffic laws.

apps.title: Millionaire Classic : Trivia
apps.summary:
How far can your knowledge take you?

Millionaire Classic: Trivia is a classic game that combines quiz games with an offline general knowledge challenge. Answer engaging questions, discover surprising facts and stay sharp as every round becomes more difficult.

Choose the correct answer from 4 options, collect virtual money and advance toward a virtual million. Knowledge, logic and smart decisions all matter. This game is for anyone who wants to be a millionaire, at least a virtual one!

Ever wondered how to be a millionaire? Here the answer is simple: choose the right answers, use your lifelines wisely and climb step by step toward a virtual million.

Love general knowledge and trivia questions? Questions from many categories help you train your brain, learn new facts every day and test what you know in a fun trivia game for every quiz fan.

Fans of question games will feel right at home. Every round brings new questions and answers, from easy warm-ups to tricky final questions that put your knowledge to the test.

Every trivia quiz session is also light brain training: you sharpen your memory, focus and logic while having fun.

Play anytime and anywhere. Single-player mode is available even offline, without an internet connection, so it's a great choice if you're looking for offline quiz games. An internet connection is required for duels, events and leaderboards.

Prefer quiz trivia offline? This quiz game is a perfect offline game for your commute, a short break or a quiet evening at home.

Need help with a tough question? Use 50/50, Ask the Audience, Ask the Expert or Replace Question to continue your run.

Ready for a real challenge? Start a duel against another player, answer the same questions and see who knows more. Win a duel, then jump into the next one and keep your streak going.

Complete daily challenges, join limited-time trivia quiz events, challenge other players in online duels and climb the global leaderboard.

Get virtual in-game money for correct answers and spend it to unlock new content.

If you enjoy quiz games, question games, questions and answers, general knowledge, brain training, a good offline game and a classic millionaire trivia game, Millionaire Classic is your next challenge. It's made for every player who wants to be a millionaire of knowledge.

Want to know how to be a millionaire in this quiz game? Answer the questions, learn new facts and start your climb to a virtual million!
